description: Audit any public review profile, named by the business's domain or its Trustpilot profile address: a bounded job that reads the profile and its low-star reviews and counts the likely-disputable ones per category, never review text. Returns {audit_id, status, result?}; while status is running, poll get_audit_result. Show the user result.summary, and result.next_step when it is not null: the two plans and the words they can say to subscribe on the one they choose (get_checkout_link), or, while billing is off, to request access. A repeat audit of a domain within the cache window returns the cached result. For your own company (customer key) the count comes from your ledger and lists your case ids. (capability: audit.run_public)
name: run_audit
